method: Self-read original PDF text and all sixteen full-page raster views. Three statistical tables enlarged separately; every numeric cell observed with span coordinates/font/hash in construction-7d-statistical-cell-observations.json. Table font reaches 5.22pt, so no minimum-font knowledge filter is permitted. Physical regions are not knowledge units.
semanticScope: Only canonical named units accepted. Other pages remain partial; unknown mapping is not proof that app content is missing. Identical human-error concepts extend prior canonical units rather than inflate the denominator. sourceContribution distinguishes basic classification from supervisory prevention.
statisticalScope: 288 numeric observations are factual extraction metadata, not 288 taught knowledge units. Selected accident columns and civil subcategories are not assumed exhaustive; residuals are retained without inventing source errors. Historical values are not current incident rates.
